notes.general_comments:
Nearly all candidates were able to show that they understood some of the topics within the syllabus.
Questions 2 and 3 were found to be accessible for most candidates, while Questions 4 and 6 proved to be
more challenging. There was no evidence of problems with the time allowed to complete the paper, except
possibly for those who used longer methods than necessary.
Candidates should be aware that probabilities must lie between 0 and 1, so an answer outside this range
ought to be checked for errors if time allows.
